info.name: E-Commerce API | Full Testing Collection
info.description:
Complete role-based Postman collection for the E-Commerce backend — Testing Team v2.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HOW TO USE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Import this collection + the environment file (ECommerce_API_Testing_Environment.json)
2. Start infrastructure: docker-compose up -d
3. Start the app: mvn spring-boot:run
4. Run in order within each role folder:
   - A = Super Admin → Browse Products → Admin sections
   - B = Seller → Browse Products → Seller Products → Cart & Orders
   - C = Customer → Browse → Cart → Orders → Wallet → Profile

Accounts (set in environment):
  Super Admin → superadmin@ecommerce.com / SuperAdmin123!
  Seller     → seller@ecommerce.com / Seller123!
  Customer   → customer@ecommerce.com / Customer123!
  Delivery   -> delivery@ecommerce.com / Delivery123!

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FOLDER STRUCTURE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

👑 A — SUPER ADMIN       Role-based tests + admin management
🏪 B — SELLER            Seller product submission workflow
🛍️ C — CUSTOMER          Full purchase lifecycle + wallet
D - DELIVERY          Assigned order delivery workflow
🧪 TESTING — PAYMOB Webhook Simulator   Webhook simulation (no real payment)
🧪 TESTING — Security & Edge Cases    Negative testing: 401/403/404/400 cases
🏥 ADMIN — Categories    Category CRUD management
🏥 ADMIN — Orders        Order status management
🛍️ CUSTOMER — Wishlist   Wishlist add/remove
🛍️ CUSTOMER — Reviews    Product reviews (5-star + 1-star)
🛍️ CUSTOMER — Coupons    Coupon validation + notifications
🔍 Search & Elasticsearch  ES search, empty query, no-results
📊 Actuator & Health      Health, info, prometheus, metrics

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FULL E2E FLOW (Customer)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  1. Login (C — Customer)
  2. Browse Products / Search
  3. Add to Cart
  4. Add address (Profile)
  5. POST /orders → walletPayment=true  → instant wallet deduction
  6. GET /wallet → see balance reduced
  7. POST /orders/{{id}}/cancel → wallet refunded
  8. GET /wallet → balance restored

  For card payment:
  5. POST /orders → walletPayment=false → PAYMOB payment URL
  6. ⚠️ Open paymentUrl in browser → pay on PAYMOB
  7. Use PAYMOB Webhook Simulator to confirm payment
  8. GET /orders/{{id}} → status = CONFIRMED

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
COLLECTION VARIABLES (auto-saved by test scripts)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  adminAccessToken / sellerAccessToken / customerAccessToken / deliveryAccessToken
  refreshToken, userId, productId, categoryId, variantId
  cartItemId, addressId, orderId, deliveryOtp, productRequestId, roleId
  walletId, PAYMOBReferenceId, paymentUrl

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
